p: in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened: Of the reign of Athaliah or after the death of Ahaziah.
chief of the fathers of Israel: Meaning of Judah and Benjamin. To see why they are called Israel, see Geneva
foundation: Which was the chief gate of the temple toward the east.
into the house: Meaning to make any tumult, or to hinder their enterprise.
were to go out on the: Who had finished their course on the Sabbath and so the other part entered to keep their turn.
temple: Meaning the most holy place where the ark stood.
testimony: That is, the book of the law or as some read they put on him his royal apparel.
Treason: Declaring her vile impudency who having unjustly and by murder usurped the crown would still have defeated the true possessor and therefore called true obedience treason.
followeth her: To join with her party and to maintain her authority.
covenant between him: That they would only serve him and renounce all idolatry.
brake it down: According to their covenant made to the Lord.
Mattan the priest of Baal before: As the Lord commanded in his law both for the person and also the city, De 13:9,15.
high gate into the king's house: Which was the principal gate that the king might be seen by all the people.
after that they had slain Athaliah: For where a tyrant and an idolater reigns there can be no peace for the plagues of God are always among such people.
